name: json
description: UTF-8 JSON or JSON-RPC text (application/json family); carried by the JSONRPC and DOC carriage vectors

name: octet-stream
description: opaque binary payload with no declared text or JSON structure (application/octet-stream family); carried by the OPAQUE carriage vector

name: text
description: UTF-8 text that is not JSON -- line/token/event protocols such as HTTP/1.x wire text; FIPA-ACL performatives; SSE event streams (text/* family); carried by the HTTP / MSG / STREAM carriage vectors
